title: Supplementary code for Voronoi Cells of Four-Dimensional Unit-Ball Packings
description: Programs, certificates, run logs and Lean 4 checks for the paper "Voronoi Cells of Four-Dimensional Unit-Ball Packings". The paper proves that a Voronoi cell of a unit-ball packing of R^4 has volume at least 8, with equality only for the 24-cell of D_4, when every neighbour that can cut the cell touches its centre, when at most twenty-three or at least thirty-one centres lie within sqrt 6 of it, or when none lies strictly between 2 + 4e-26 and sqrt 6. It reduces the other cells to two explicit statements, (G) and (C), which together imply that D_4 gives the densest packing of R^4 and which remain open. The package contains the exact chamber certificates of the single-deviation bound; the covering bound; the root-system and 600-cell enumerations; the three-point certificate for twenty-three contacts, verified in exact rational, interval and Lean arithmetic; the zonal matrices and polynomial identities of the certificate of de Laat, Leijenhorst and de Muinck Keizer for twenty-four contacts, recomputed in exact arithmetic on an ordinary machine; the certificate that no 25 points of S^3 have pairwise inner products at most 1/2 + 0.008; the distance criterion, the labelled certificate for at most twenty-three centres within sqrt 6 and the explicit constant of the near-contact theorem, in ball and exact arithmetic; the second order of the cell volume at the root system; the two-point certificates for thirty-one or more centres and the counts and radial bounds for (C) and (G); the hole budget beside a near root system; the second-level programme of de Laat, Leijenhorst and de Muinck Keizer set up from the recomputed zonal matrices; Lean 4 checks of the finite arithmetic and polynomial identities of these steps; and an independent re-verification of the computations. Part of the code was developed with the assistance of Claude, an AI model made by Anthropic.
